facts.fact: India's Ministry of External Affairs says Ooru Digital is implementing a MOSIP-based National Digital Identity system and a National Citizen Portal for São Tomé and Príncipe, enabling access to public services through National ID-based login, and that the portal was launched on 27 March 2026.

STP.note: No link between civil register and ID system is stated.
No count or share of people enrolled is stated.
No identity number at birth is stated.
Names a foreign company implementing the system; no operation, transfer or ownership is stated.
No public register keyed on the ID number is stated.

facts.fact: India's Ministry of External Affairs says Ooru Digital is implementing a MOSIP-based National Digital Identity system for São Tomé and Príncipe, funded by the World Bank and CDPI.
